facts.text: Under the Guaranteed Access Partnership Program (GAPP), Stevenson University provides recipients of Maryland's Guaranteed Access Grant with a matching grant up to the full amount of tuition and fees.

sources.title: GAPP | Stevenson University
sources.quote: through the new Guaranteed Access Partnership Program (GAPP), Stevenson University is proud to provide recipients of the Guaranteed Access Grant with a matching grant, up to the full amount of our tuition and fees.

facts.text: Stevenson University was originally founded in 1947 by the Sisters of Notre Dame de Namur as Villa Julie College, before the Board of Trustees voted to change its name to Stevenson University.

sources.title: University History | Stevenson University
sources.quote: Villa Julie College is founded by the Sisters of Notre Dame de Namur at “Seven Oaks,” an 80-acre estate in Greenspring Valley, formerly the home of the George Carrell Jenkins family.

sources.title: University History | Stevenson University
sources.quote: On June 11, the Board of Trustees voted to change the name of Villa Julie College to Stevenson University.
